prompt: Only after the economic data had been meticulously analyzed by the board ______ to implement the new fiscal policy.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after' ile başlayan cümleler ana cümlede devrik (Inversion) yapı gerektirir. Eylem geçmişte yaşandığı için 'did + S + V1' yapısı kullanılmalıdır.

prompt: It is essential that the researcher ______ the variables carefully before the experiment ______ to the final stage.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is essential that' yapısı Subjunctive gerektirir (fiil yalın: document). Cümlenin ikinci kısmı ise genel bir süreci anlatan düz 'Present Simple' (proceeds) gerektirir.

prompt: The suspect is believed ______ the secure server multiple times before the breach ______ by the IT department.
E: to be accessed / had been noticed
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is believed' (inanılıyor - şimdi) yapısından daha önce gerçekleşmiş bir eylem (accessed - geçmiş) için 'Perfect Infinitive' (to have V3) kullanılır. İkinci boşluk ise 'before' sonrası pasif geçmiş zaman (was noticed) gerektirir.

prompt: Had the engineers ______ the structural defect during the initial inspection, the bridge ______ collapse now.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Had' ile başlayan devrik yapı Type 3 Conditional (geçmiş pişmanlık) başlatır. Ancak cümlenin sonundaki 'now' ifadesi 'Mixed Conditional' yapısına işaret eder; yani sonuç kısmı Type 2 (wouldn't) olmalıdır.

prompt: By the time the new regulations ______ into effect next year, most corporations ______ their internal compliance systems.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time + Present, Future Perfect' kuralı. Gelecekte bir zaman dilimine kadar tamamlanmış olacak eylemler için 'will have V3' kullanılır.

prompt: Rarely ______ a political figure managed to polarize the public ______ as the current prime minister has done.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion) devrik yapı ister. Cümlenin sonundaki 'has done' ile uyumlu olarak 'has manage(d)' yapısı devrilmiştir (has a political figure managed). 'as/so ... as' kalıbı miktarı niteler.

prompt: The manager suggested that the project ______ until the funding ______ by the board of directors.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Suggest that' (Subjunctive) gereği fiil yalın olmalıdır; proje erteleneceği için pasif yalın (be postponed) kullanılır. 'Until' bağlacı sonrası Future kullanılmaz, Present (is approved) tercih edilir.

prompt: No sooner ______ the satellite reached its orbit ______ it began transmitting high-resolution data back to Earth.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' kalıbı (yapar yapmaz) devrik yapı (had + S + V3) ile kullanılır. 'Hardly/Scarcely' olsaydı 'when' gelirdi.

prompt: Not for a moment ______ the defense attorney doubt her client's innocence, ______ of the evidence presented by the prosecution.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not for a moment' (olumsuz zarf öbeği) Inversion gerektirir. 'Regardless of' (bakılmaksızın) ifadesi anlamı tamamlar.

prompt: If the government ______ the interest rates last month, the inflation rate ______ so rapidly today.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Geçmişteki bir eylemin (last month) şimdiki sonucunu (today) anlatan 'Mixed Conditional' (Type 3 + Type 2) yapısı.

prompt: Under no circumstances ______ employees allow unauthorized personnel to access the main server room.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Under no circumstances' (Asla/Hiçbir koşulda) devrik yapı ve bir tavsiye/zorunluluk kuralı olarak 'should' veya 'must' gerektirir. YDS'de bu bağlamda 'should' daha yaygındır.

prompt: The archaeologist, ______ groundbreaking work in Egypt is well-known, has recently discovered a new tomb ______ to the 18th Dynasty.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İyelik bildiren Relative Clause (whose work). İkinci kısım ise 'which belongs' ifadesinin 'belonging' şeklinde kısaltılmasıdır.

prompt: Were the vaccine ______ safer, the public ______ much more willing to participate in the trial.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Were + S + to V1' (Type 2 Conditional devrik hali). Şu anki hayali durumu anlatır.

prompt: Scarcely ______ the witness began her testimony ______ the judge interrupted her to ask a clarifying question.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' kalıbı (Inversion: had + S + V3) kuralıdır.

prompt: The CEO insisted that the audit ______ by an external firm to ensure the ______ of the financial report.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Insist that' (Subjunctive) edilgen yapı gereği 'be V3' (be conducted) olur. İkinci kısımda 'the'dan sonra isim (objectivity) gelmelidir.

prompt: So complex ______ the mathematical equation that even the most advanced AI ______ solve it in under an hour.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So + Adjective + be + S + that' yapısı bir devrik yapıdır. 'Was' (geçmiş/durum) ve 'couldn't' (yeteneksizlik) uyumludur.

prompt: The company reported ______ a loss in the first quarter, ______ many investors to sell their shares.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Report to have V3' (yapmış olduğu rapor edilmek). Virgül sonrası 'causing' (-erek/-arak) bir sonuç cümlesi kısaltmasıdır.

prompt: Not only ______ the experimental drug stabilize the patient's condition, but it also ______ the risk of future complications.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not only' (Inversion: did + S + V1) ve devamında 'but also' ile paralel zaman (reduced) kullanımı.

prompt: It is high time the government ______ more stringent measures to combat the ______ threat of cyber terrorism.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is high time' yapısından sonra fiil Past Simple (V2) olur (took). 'Rising' ise tehdidi niteleyen bir sıfattır.

prompt: Little ______ the explorers know that the cave ______ for thousands of years before they discovered it.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little' (Inversion: did ... know). 'Before' öncesi daha geçmişi anlattığı için Past Perfect Passive (had been inhabited) kullanılır.

prompt: The witness ______ to have seen the suspect ______ the building shortly before the explosion occurred.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Claim to have V3' (yaptığını iddia etmek). Birini bir şeyi yaparken görmek (see someone V-ing) yapısı.

prompt: Only by ______ the data from multiple sources ______ the researchers confirm the reliability of their findings.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only by + V-ing' yapısı ana cümlede devriklik (could the researchers confirm) gerektirir.

prompt: The professor recommended that the student ______ the literature review ______ more recent studies.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Recommend that' (Subjunctive: fiil yalın). 'To include' ise amaç bildirir (dahil etmek için).

prompt: Should there ______ any further delays in the supply chain, the production line ______ shut down by Friday.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should' devrik Type 1. 'Should there be' (olursa). Gelecek zorunluluk (will have to).

prompt: Such ______ the force of the impact that the structural integrity of the entire vessel ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such + be + S + that' (devrik yapı). Etki o kadar büyüktü ki (was). Bütün geminin bütünlüğü sarsıldı (passive: was compromised).

prompt: Not until the final results ______ published ______ the public realize the extent of the environmental damage.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past, did + S + V1) dizilimi.

prompt: The CEO is thought ______ the company’s expansion plans during the secret meeting ______ last night.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Pasif inanış (is thought) + geçmiş eylem (to have V3). 'Meeting (which was) held' (yapılan toplantı) kısaltması.

prompt: Rarely ______ such an intricate mechanism ______ by ancient civilizations, according to latest archaeological finds.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). Mekanizma 'keşfedildiği' için Present Perfect Passive devriği (has ... been discovered).

prompt: It is mandatory that every employee ______ the safety drill, ______ of their rank or department.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Mandatory that' (Subjunctive: attend). 'Regardless of' (bakılmaksızın).

prompt: Had the rescue team ______ sooner, they ______ more people from the sinking ship.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional (geçmiş pişmanlık) devrik hali (Had + S + V3 / could have V3).

prompt: No matter how hard the scientists ______, they ______ to find a cure for the rare genetic disorder.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No matter how' (zıtlık). Ne kadar denerlerse denesinler (tried), başarısız oldular (have failed).

prompt: But for the quick thinking of the pilot, the plane ______ into the mountainside ______ the storm.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'But for' (-olmasaydı - Type 3). Pilotun hızı olmasaydı uçak çarpacaktı (would have crashed).

prompt: Neither the manager ______ the employees ______ aware of the security breach until the alarm went off.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Neither ... nor' (ne o ne öbürü). Fiil en yakın özneye göre çekimlenir (employees -> were).

prompt: Scarcely ______ the sun set ______ the temperature began to drop below freezing point.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' standart gramer kalıbıdır.

prompt: It is essential that the witness ______ the truth, lest an innocent man ______ convicted.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Hem 'essential that' hem de 'lest' (olmasın diye) yapıları 'Subjunctive' (yalın fiil: tell / be) gerektirir.

prompt: Under no circumstances ______ the project manager ______ to share the client's data with third parties.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Under no circumstances' (Inversion). Tavsiye/Yasak (should agree).

prompt: The building, ______ construction was delayed by the strike, ______ finally be completed next month.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Building whose construction' (inşaatı geciken bina). Gelecek zaman (will).

prompt: Only after having ______ the data multiple times ______ the researchers feel confident in their conclusions.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after' (Inversion: did ... feel).

prompt: Little ______ we imagine that the small startup ______ become a global tech giant in just a decade.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little did we imagine' (Hayal bile edemezdik). 'Would' ise gelecek tahmini.

prompt: The suspect is alleged ______ the painting ______ last year's gala at the national gallery.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Alleged to have stolen' (çaldığı iddia ediliyor). 'During the gala' (gala sırasında).

prompt: Were it not for the generous donations from the alumni, the library ______ its doors long ago.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Were it not for' (Type 3 devrik / olmasaydı). Geçmişteki sonuç (would have V3).

prompt: Not until the satellite ______ the edge of the solar system ______ it send back the most distant images ever taken.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past, did + S + V1) kuralı.

prompt: The evidence ______ by the forensic team indicates that the fire ______ deliberately.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Evidence (which was) gathered' (toplanan kanıt). Ateş yakıldığı için pasif (was set).

prompt: It is vital that the committee ______ the ethical implications before the new law ______ enacted.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Vital that' (Subjunctive: consider). 'Before' sonrası Present Simple (is).

prompt: Rarely ______ such a complex issue ______ with so much clarity and precision as in this report.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). Konu 'ele alındığı' için pasif (has ... been addressed).

prompt: The more ______ the research, the more ______ the findings are likely to be.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' (paralel karşılaştırma). Her iki kısımda da sıfat (adjective) kullanılmalıdır.

prompt: Should the volatile situation in the region ______, the United Nations ______ to intervene.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should' devrik Type 1. 'Should worsen' (kötüleşirse). Gelecek zorunluluk (will have to).

prompt: The suspect, ______ motives remain unclear, ______ being questioned by the detectives since this morning.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Whose motives' (motifleri belirsiz olan kişi). 'Since' kuralı (has been being questioned).

prompt: It is recommended that the patient ______ from smoking and ______ a healthy diet.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Recommended that' (Subjunctive). Her iki fiil de yalın olmalıdır.

prompt: No sooner ______ the whistle blown ______ the players began to argue with the referee.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' standart kalıp.

prompt: Had the warnings ______ seriously by the local residents, the casualties ______ much lower.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 devrik ve pasif (Had the warnings been taken). Sonuç (would have been).

prompt: Not until the implementation of the new law ______ the crime rate ______ to decline significantly.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past: did ... begin).

prompt: The witness ______ to have seen the perpetrator ______ the scene shortly before the police arrived.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Claims to have V3' (yaptığını iddia eder). Birini yaparken görmek (leaving).

prompt: It is imperative that the team ______ the deadline, lest the entire project ______ cancelled.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Çift Subjunctive (meet / be).

prompt: Scarcely ______ the conductor raised his baton ______ the orchestra began to play the symphony.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' kalıbı.

prompt: Such ______ the complexity of the task that it ______ more than three years to complete.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such was the complexity' (Karmaşıklık o kadardı ki). Geçmiş zaman uyumu.

prompt: Only after ______ the evidence ______ the judge decide to release the suspect on bail.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after V-ing' (Inversion: did the judge decide).

prompt: Little ______ the explorers know that the map they were using ______ outdated for years.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little did they know' (Çok az biliyorlardı/Bilmiyorlardı). 'Had been' (öncesinden beri öyleydi).

prompt: The athlete is thought ______ the world record ______ the upcoming international competition.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is thought to break' (kırması bekleniyor/düşünülüyor - gelecek). 'At the competition' (yarışmada).

prompt: Were the government ______ swifter action, the economic crisis ______ avoided.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 2 devrik (Were ... to take). Sonuç (could be).

prompt: Neither the supervisor ______ the team members ______ the password to the main server.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Neither ... nor'. 'Team members' çoğul olduğu için 'have' kullanılır.

prompt: Not until the ship ______ the harbor ______ the passengers begin to disembark.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past: did ... begin).

prompt: It is essential that the scientist ______ the data meticulously to avoid ______ the results.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Essential that' (Subjunctive: analyze). 'Avoid + V-ing' (skewing).

prompt: Rarely ______ a single discovery ______ the potential to transform so many different industries.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). 'Has a discovery had' (Present Perfect devriği).

prompt: The more ______ the training program, the more ______ the employees will be to new challenges.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' + Sıfat + Sıfat.

prompt: Should you ______ any further assistance, please do not hesitate ______ our customer service.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should require' (devrik Type 1). 'Hesitate + to V1' (to contact).

prompt: The research, ______ findings were published in a medical journal, ______ been funded by a private donor.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Research whose findings' (bulguları yayınlanan araştırma). 'Research has been' (tekil).

prompt: It is mandatory that every passenger ______ their seatbelt during takeoff and ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Mandatory that' (Subjunctive: fasten). 'Takeoff and landing' (isim öbekleri).

prompt: No sooner ______ the satellite launched ______ the engineers detected a serious mechanical failure.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' kalıbı.

prompt: Had the warnings ______ seriously by the local authorities, the casualties ______ much lower.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional (geçmiş devrik pasif).

prompt: Not until the implementation of the new law ______ the crime rate ______ to decline significantly.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' (Past: did ... begin).

prompt: The witness ______ to have seen the suspect ______ the bank shortly before the alarm went off.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Claims to have V3' (yaptığını iddia eder). Birini yaparken görmek (leaving).

prompt: It is imperative that the team ______ the deadline, lest the entire project ______ cancelled.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Çift Subjunctive (meet / be).

prompt: Scarcely ______ the conductor raised his baton ______ the orchestra began to play.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Scarcely ... when' kalıbı.

prompt: Such ______ the force of the blast that the structural integrity of the entire building ______.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Such was the force' (Güç o kadardı ki). Geçmiş zaman uyumu.

prompt: Only after ______ the data ______ the researchers feel confident in their conclusions.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after V-ing' (Inversion: did the researchers feel).

prompt: Little ______ the explorers know that the cave ______ for thousands of years before they found it.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little did they know' (Bilmiyorlardı). 'Had been' (öncesinden beri öyleydi).

prompt: The athlete is thought ______ the world record ______ the upcoming international competition.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is thought to break' (kırması bekleniyor/düşünülüyor). 'At the competition' (yarışmada).

prompt: Were the government ______ swifter action, the economic crisis ______ avoided.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 2 devrik (Were ... to take). Sonuç (could be).

prompt: The discovery was considered ______; it not only solved a linguistic mystery but also provided a map of the city.
explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Pivotal' (çok önemli, hayati). Dönüm noktası niteliğindeki gelişmeler.
